comment: DATED EVIDENCE, NOT A LIVE CHECK. These are the EvidenceClass variants neural-memory-server actually defines, read from its source at the commit named below. `cargo test` here cannot see that repository, and there is no runtime oracle either: its MCP surface exposes no tool that returns the enum, because crates/neural-memory-store/src/write.rs:266-269 clamps every agent write to agentInference before the digest is computed. So this file plus scripts/check-evidence-class-drift.sh is the whole mechanism — the test binds the mapping to this list in CI, and the script re-reads the sibling checkout on demand. Re-run the script and update checkedAgainstCommit before changing the mapping in provenance.rs.
